## What's new

- **Public Instagram profiles without signing in, all of them.** A profile opened signed out now pages through all of its posts instead of the first ones. **Back up this profile** works without a sign-in, in the app, with `turbodl` and from Python.
  - Instagram shows signed-out visitors only each post's cover, so TurboDL reads every post from its own page, a few seconds apart. A 50-post profile takes a few minutes; a 1,000-post profile takes hours.
  - While it reads this way, the backup panel and the command's progress say so.
  - Posts already saved are not read again on the next run.
- **Highlights without signing in.** The Highlights tab, **Back up highlights**, `--highlights` and highlight links all work signed out.
- **Posts shown only to signed-in visitors are skipped and counted.** The backup panel shows how many there were. A job still ends with what it could save, and says `<n> posts are shown only to signed-in visitors; sign in to save them.`
- **Stopping at Instagram's sign-in wall.** If Instagram answers a signed-out read with its sign-in page, TurboDL stops at once. It keeps what it saved, waits as it does when Instagram asks it to slow down, and continues from there next time.
- **Signing in.** Signing in from a profile seen signed out reopens it with your session. Signed in, everything works as before.

Saved, current stories, story links, posts shown only to signed-in visitors and private profiles still need a sign-in.

## Updating

- Install the new version over the old one and open TurboDL once.
- **For scripts.** `turbodl`'s exit code 3 and Python's `SignInRequired` now also mean "some of this profile's posts are shown only to signed-in visitors". The other posts are saved, and the job's files list them.
- **Older backups.** If you backed up a profile signed in with 0.6.0 and now back it up signed out, the first run reads each post's page once to recognise what's already saved. Later runs stop early as usual.
- **Extension.** The browser extension has not changed; there is nothing to reload.
- **Firefox.** Open `TurboDL-Firefox-0.7.0.xpi` in Firefox. Regular Firefox only installs add-ons signed by Mozilla. If this file is unsigned, use Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR with `xpinstall.signatures.required` set to `false`.

The Windows installer is not signed yet: choose **More info → Run anyway**.
